National polls in recent months have shown that the president is losing support among younger voters and independents, particularly those opposed to the ongoing and uncertain war in Iran.

According to RealClearPolitics polling averages of national surveys, just 39% of voters nationally approve of Trump’s performance as president while 58% disapprove.
